issues.description: Method Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (task description and UML) specifies a method with signature addGuestStudents(int, String) — i.e. two parameters (an int for number of new guest students and a String reason). The solution implementation defines addGuestStudents with a single int parameter: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). The template contains a TODO for this method but no concrete signature. This discrepancy leaves students unsure which signature to implement and may cause failing tests or API mismatch between student code and the expected solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent. Either (A) change the solution method signature to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and update its body to add the given number of guest students (the reason can be stored, logged, or ignored but must be accepted), or (B) update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) only. Prefer (A) to preserve the current exercise description: implement the two-parameter method in the solution (and update the template to include the same signature) so students and tests use the same API.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a method named addGuestStudents that accepts two parameters: an int and a String (addGuestStudents(int, String)) to add guest students with a reason. The solution implementation defines a method with the same name but a different signature: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (only the int parameter). The template contains a TODO for this method but no stub. This signature mismatch (two-parameter API in the problem vs. one-parameter API in the solution) prevents a clear one-to-one mapping: students following the problem will implement or call addGuestStudents(int, String) but the provided solution uses addGuestStudents(int), causing confusion about the expected API and how to handle the reason parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signatures consistent. Preferred: update the solution to implement the two-parameter method declared in the problem: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and handle or store the reason (for example, add a field to store the latest reason or include it in toString/log output). Alternative: if the reason parameter is unnecessary, update the problem statement and UML to require only public void addGuestStudents(int) and adjust the textual task accordingly. Prefer updating the solution to match the problem so the reference implementation follows the specified API.
